summary: Native Paxlet node catalog and revisioned withdrawal snapshots

delivery.outcome: A usable local operator CLI and transactional Paxlet-native catalog with explicit namespace ownership, local approvals and bounded revisioned snapshots that preserve withdrawals.
nonGoals: Replacing live gateway/MCP/legacy registry consumers in this slice
Execution grants or automatic activation from remote snapshots

architecture.decision: Use verified Paxlet content storage unchanged; SQLite owns node identity, namespace ownership, logical entries/revisions and local activation/aliases. One namespace writer, immutable identity/version assignments and permanent withdrawal markers prevent rollback/resurrection; no replicated approvals or execution. Start with an explicit operator CLI and test independent nodes before routing live consumers. The new opt-in catalog.sqlite is component-local state only. No existing persistent data is moved, re-keyed or migrated; existing generated registries and live consumers are untouched.
interfaceChanges: Operator catalog CLI and Python API
Versioned full snapshots with explicit authenticated-origin binding
architecture.rollback: Stop using the opt-in catalog; preserve its database and Paxlet objects. No existing files are migrated or deleted.

validation.evidence: Host and isolated Docker native catalog tests, actual Paxlet import, three independent nodes, stale/withdrawn/conflict/failure/concurrency cases.
